brand.name: Deck Club
brand.description: Free, open-source flashcards with spaced repetition. Your own AI assistant makes the cards.

landing.title: Remember what you learn.
landing.lead: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to turn an article into cards. Review them here for a few minutes a day, alone or with your club.

points.free: Free and open source, no ads, no tracking.
points.ai: Your AI makes the cards. Deck Club never calls an AI itself.
points.schedule: A proven spaced repetition schedule decides what comes back, and when.

landing.sampleBack: Turns food into energy the cell can use.

signIn.title: Sign in to Deck Club
signIn.lead: We send you a one-time link. No password to remember.
signIn.sentLead: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
signIn.failed: The link could not be sent. Wait a minute and try again.

auth.callbackFailed: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

library.title: Your decks
library.lead: Every deck you create here or through your AI assistant.
library.cardCount: {count, plural, =0 {No cards yet} one {# card} other {# cards}}
library.emptyLead: Create your first deck below, or ask your AI assistant to make one.
library.loadFailed: Your decks could not be loaded.

create.title: New deck
create.descriptionHint: Optional. One sentence about what the deck covers.
create.failed: The deck could not be created.

detail.loadFailed: This deck could not be loaded.
detail.notFound: This deck does not exist or was deleted.
detail.confirmDelete: Delete “{title}”? You can ask for it back within 30 days.
detail.deleteFailed: The deck could not be deleted.
detail.emptyCards: No cards yet. Write the first one above, or ask your AI to add some.

editor.title: Add a card
editor.hint: Type the front, press Tab, type the back, press Enter. The next card is ready right away.
editor.extraHint: Optional. An example, an explanation or a source.
editor.failed: The card could not be added.

card.saveFailed: The card could not be saved.
card.deleteFailed: The card could not be deleted.

connectAi.title: Connect your AI
connectAi.lead: Deck Club has an MCP server. Add it to your assistant and it can list your decks, create decks and add cards for you. It uses your own AI subscription, never ours.
connectAi.tokenLead: Until one-click sign-in for assistants is ready, your assistant uses a temporary access token. It expires after an hour. Treat it like a password.
connectAi.tokenFailed: Sign in again to get a new token.
connectAi.clientsTitle: Add the server to your assistant
connectAi.claudeCodeStep: Run this in your terminal, with the token in place of TOKEN:
connectAi.otherClientsStep: Add a custom connector with the server URL above and send the token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
